history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration develop detailed guidelines for ICT asset and inventory management for Secretariat entities to support their effective and efficient management of ICT assets management and sourcing.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that the recommendation be closed. Detailed guidelines for ICT asset and inventory management to support Secretariat entities in the management and sourcing of ICT assets are in place. Evidence was submitted to show the relevant policies and guidance documents, which cover all pertinent aspects of asset and inventory management. The evidence provided addresses ICT asset management and sourcing, along with roles and responsibilities, delegation, policies and tracking procedures. All these documents are readily available in the Knowledge Gateway portal.
history.board_assessment: Given that the guidelines are acceptable and in place, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
